sloka: देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः ।सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः ।। ५.३९.३३।।।।
transliteration: devi haryṛkṣasainyānāmīśvaraḥ plavatāṁ varaḥ ।sugrīvaḥ sattvasampannastavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ ।। 5.39.33।।।।

translations.english: "O Devi the lord of monkeys, Sugriva heads the army of vanaras and bears. He is richly endowed with satvaguna and is determined to accomplish your cause and free you from sorrow.
